findings.title: PR review workflow vulnerable to prompt injection via diff content
findings.notes: LLM prompt embeds PR diff without injection-resistant framing; unvalidated output posted as PR comment. Fix: untrusted-content delimiters, system instruction hardening, comment disclaimer.

findings.title: list_files enumerates host files through workspace symlinks
findings.notes: list_files uses Path.glob() which follows symlinks without resolving matches against workspace root. Same class as #13 (search_files) but in a different function not covered by PR #26. Fix: resolve each glob match and reject outside workspace. PR #31 was closed without merging by maintainer.

findings.title: MCP stdio env denylist missing GCONV_PATH / PERL5OPT / PERL5LIB / RUBYOPT / RUBYLIB loader-injection keys

tracking.upstream_pr: DENIED (fork-scoped App); open manually via compare_url

findings.notes: DANGEROUS_MCP_ENV_KEYS backstop for the mcp_stdio_command_allowlist listed PATH/LD_PRELOAD/LD_AUDIT/DYLD_*/PYTHON*/NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH/BASH_ENV/ENV but omitted same-class loader/interpreter code-injection vars. GCONV_PATH (glibc loads attacker .so on next iconv, hits ANY glibc binary like LD_PRELOAD, not just interpreters) and PERL5OPT/PERL5LIB, RUBYOPT/RUBYLIB (Perl/Ruby analogues of PYTHONPATH/NODE_OPTIONS) passed reject_dangerous_env_keys and merged into the spawned MCP server env, so a config pinning command to a trusted wrapper could still inject code. Defense-in-depth (low sev): only relevant when an admin has configured mcp_stdio_command_allowlist; prerequisites (attacker file on disk + matching wrapper) identical to the already-listed LD_PRELOAD/PYTHONPATH entries. Fix: added the 5 keys to the frozenset + parametrized test in tests/test_mcp_policy.py, based on upstream d9f76a5, authored as Herik Webb, single commit 'fix(mcp): deny GCONV_PATH and perl/ruby loader keys in stdio env denylist'. Logic verified directly (module loaded standalone; new keys rejected incl. case/whitespace forms; safe keys + existing entries unaffected; full pytest not run - env lacks tiktoken/optional deps). Pushed to fork origin. Cross-fork PR into upstream DENIED (session GitHub scope fork-only) -> open manually via compare_url. Fork-only-file guard passed; git log author verified Herik Webb. Found via 4-surface parallel Pass B review; only validated non-duplicate finding this run.
